why_ai: Taste-led design delivered through site visits, showrooms and installs, with some licensing; AI rendering and e-design threaten the low end only.
why_clarity: Good design is a matter of the client's taste, each designer works by eye, and every project is bespoke.
why_digital: Starts from rooms and samples, produced partly on screen, delivered as a physical finished room to mostly local clients.

why_ai: Affluent clients pay for a specific designer's eye and for someone to manage every order and install.
why_clarity: Success is client delight and a delivered home, judged subjectively and months later.
why_digital: Home visits, showrooms and installed rooms, sold locally by referral.

why_ai: Code compliance and stamped drawings in some states protect the work; layouts and programming are increasingly automated.
why_clarity: Programs and budgets are measurable but design quality and fit to culture are debated.
why_digital: Drawings and data on screen, delivered as a built office for a local occupier.

why_ai: Fast layout and cost work on screen that generative tools already produce.
why_clarity: Fit the headcount into the plate within budget: a clear, frequent, checkable task.
why_digital: Floor plans in, layouts and budgets out, delivered to brokers digitally.

why_ai: Data analysis is automatable, but recommendations carry organisational politics and trust.
why_clarity: Demand curves are measurable, but whether a recommendation was right shows only after occupancy.
why_digital: Sensor, badge and booking data in, programs and reports out.

why_ai: PIP cycles guarantee demand, and brand approval and code rules keep accountable designers in the loop.
why_clarity: Brand standards and PIP items define the deliverable, and sister properties repeat it.
why_digital: PIPs and standards in, spec books on screen, delivered as renovated hotels for owners anywhere.

why_ai: Receiving, inspection and white-glove delivery are physical; the paperwork around them is automatable.
why_clarity: Right item, right finish, right date: an exact, checkable, highly repetitive deliverable.
why_digital: Paper and email trail around physical goods moving through warehouses to homes.

why_ai: Clients hire this specific person; the admin around the design is what AI absorbs.
why_clarity: Taste-led bespoke work with subjective, slow verdicts.
why_digital: Local, in-person design delivered as finished rooms.

why_ai: Life-safety, infection-control and accessibility rules require accountable specifiers, and care-setting construction keeps growing.
why_clarity: Code and cleanability requirements are explicit, but finish performance is known only years later.
why_digital: Codes and product data on screen, delivered as built care facilities.

why_ai: Pure product-data capture that extraction models already perform.
why_clarity: A complete spec line is exactly checkable and recurs thousands of times.
why_digital: Web pages and PDFs in, structured data out, entirely online.

why_ai: Generative image models substitute for rendering labour directly.
why_clarity: Image matches the selections is checkable; persuasive is a matter of taste.
why_digital: Models and photos in, images out, often outsourced abroad.

why_ai: Site inventories and signed appraisals keep a credentialed human involved; depreciation tables are automatable.
why_clarity: Appraisal methods are codified and recur annually, but value is only tested if challenged.
why_digital: Physical inventories in, digital reports out to owners nationwide.

why_ai: Professional cost judgement on new projects persists; quantity take-off is being automated.
why_clarity: Estimates are checkable against tender and final cost, on repeatable project types.
why_digital: Drawings and cost data in, cost plans out, delivered digitally.

why_ai: The benchmark's value is the comparable dataset, which AI cannot generate; the survey work is software.
why_clarity: Standard survey and score, highly repetitive, but whether scores predict outcomes is rarely tested.
why_digital: Survey data in, benchmark reports out, sold online globally.

why_ai: Property walks, brand negotiation and owner trust keep this human and relationship-led.
why_clarity: PIP scopes are defined, but negotiated outcomes and costs vary deal by deal.
why_digital: Hotel inspections and PIPs in, digital scopes and plans out.

why_ai: Panels and relationships with designers are hard to substitute; report writing is not.
why_clarity: Survey methods are codified but findings are rarely validated against outcomes.
why_digital: Interviews and surveys in, reports out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Forecasting judgement is valued, but trend synthesis from observable signals is exposed to AI.
why_clarity: Forecasts are judged by taste and almost never graded against what sold.
why_digital: Observation and data in, digital reports out to subscribers worldwide.

why_ai: Logistics and installation keep some physical work; bid tabulation and pricing are automatable.
why_clarity: Bids, orders and deliveries are exact, repeatable and quickly checked.
why_digital: POs and bids on screen, physical goods delivered to hotels.

why_ai: Sample logistics are physical; the search and matching layer is software.
why_clarity: Ship the right sample overnight: exact, repetitive and instantly checked.
why_digital: Online ordering of physical samples shipped nationally.

why_ai: Configuration and BOM work is rule-bound and automatable; dealer relationships persist.
why_clarity: Accurate BOMs and code-compliant layouts are exact and frequent.
why_digital: CET layouts on screen, furniture delivered to local occupiers.

why_ai: Brand identity and approval authority keep this team; document checking is automatable.
why_clarity: Standards are written rules applied to many properties.
why_digital: Standards and approvals managed digitally across a global portfolio.

why_ai: Observational research has some protection; publishing insight content is exposed.
why_clarity: Research questions vary and findings are rarely validated.
why_digital: Studies and data in, published research out.

why_ai: Remote design packages are directly substitutable by generative design tools.
why_clarity: Packages are standardised and client approval is quick, though taste-driven.
why_digital: Fully online design with physical products shipped to clients.

why_ai: Thought-leadership research carries some brand value but little protection.
why_clarity: Bespoke studies with no objective test of correctness.
why_digital: Research produced and published digitally.

why_ai: Credentialing authority and membership endure regardless of AI.
why_clarity: Exams and member surveys are standardised and recur.
why_digital: Administered and delivered largely online.

why_ai: Statutory authority guarantees the function; the administration is automatable.
why_clarity: Registration and renewal rules are explicit and repetitive.
why_digital: Applications and records handled digitally within one state.

why_ai: Survey-based rankings are cheap to replicate and exposed to AI summarisation.
why_clarity: Annual survey methodology repeats, but rankings rely on self-reported data.
why_digital: Surveys in, articles and rankings published online.
